submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE was 0.840% at Sb=0.411. Its neighbour at Sb=0.379 gave 0.826%, so the peak is broad and flat around Sb≈0.38–0.41. A log-quadratic fit to the other points puts the maximum near Sb≈0.40. XRD shows the same single phase from Sb=0.28 to 0.49. A second phase appears by Sb=0.585, and EQE falls to about 0.01% on the Sb-rich side (0.675 and 0.816).
